Patient Privacy & Data Protection

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 2026 | Last Updated: November 2026

At Charak Health Solutions (operated under the clinical leadership of Dr. Surabhi Sunil Vaidya), we are deeply committed to safeguarding the privacy and confidentiality of our patients and website visitors. This Privacy Policy explains how your personal data, symptom responses, and booking references are collected, processed, and safeguarded in accordance with applicable Indian laws, including the Information Technology Act, 2000 and Digital Personal Data Protection guidelines.

1. Information We Collect

When you interact with our website, take our pain assessment, book a consultation, or register for an educational webinar, we collect only the information necessary to deliver our services:

  • Patient Contact Information: Full name, WhatsApp-enabled mobile phone number, optional email address (used for calendar invitations and webinar room links), and city/area of residence.
  • Questionnaire & Symptom Responses: Primary area of pain (knee, lower back/spine, neck/cervical, multiple joints), reported pain severity in daily activities, history of prior medical treatments (such as surgery advice, painkiller use, or physiotherapy), and your self-reported treatment readiness stage. This information is collected solely to suggest a suitable care pathway and help Dr. Surabhi Vaidya prepare for clinical evaluations.
  • Booking & Payment Reference Details: Selected appointment date and time slot, service chosen (Consultation ₹1,000 or Webinar ₹201), unique payment reference comment (e.g. CHK-9820145872-482), transaction or UTR reference number, and booking confirmation status.
  • Technical & Analytical Browsing Data: Anonymized device information, browser type, and aggregate site interaction metrics captured through functional cookies and Google analytics tags to maintain site performance.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information strictly for legitimate medical practice and service delivery purposes:

  • Pathway Recommendations: Evaluating your questionnaire responses to suggest the most appropriate next step (attending an educational webinar online or scheduling an in-clinic diagnostic visit).
  • Appointment Scheduling & Coordination: Reserving your 30-minute diagnostic consultation slot on the clinic calendar.
  • Service Delivery & Notifications: Dispatching instant booking confirmations, clinic address details, Google Maps navigation links, and appointment reminder alerts via WhatsApp and SMS.
  • Webinar Room Access: Generating unique access tokens and delivering broadcast links for our live interactive sessions on Webinar.gg.
  • Clinical Preparation: Providing Dr. Surabhi Vaidya with prior context before your physical consultation to facilitate an efficient, personalized evaluation.

3. Third-Party Service Providers & Infrastructure

We rely on reputable, industry-standard technology service providers to host our website, manage schedules, and process payments securely:

  • Hosting & Compute Infrastructure: Vercel Inc. (secure cloud hosting and serverless functions).
  • Database & Lead Management: Supabase Inc. (encrypted cloud database with Row-Level Security for patient inquiries).
  • Appointment Scheduling: Cal.id (calendar availability and appointment slot reservation).
  • Live Educational Broadcasts: Webinar.gg (interactive live video broadcast room).
  • Messaging & Delivery: Official WhatsApp Business API providers (for automated appointment confirmations, joining links, and reminders).
  • Payment Processing: Direct UPI network and Reserve Bank of India (RBI) authorized payment aggregators (such as PayU / Cashfree). Charak Health Solutions does not collect or store card numbers, CVVs, or UPI PINs.
  • Website Analytics & Conversion Tags: Google Tag / Google Ads conversion tracking (Conversion ID: AW-18534158307) and Vercel Analytics for aggregate usage insights.

4. Communication Practices: Booking Updates vs. Promotional Consent

We respect your inbox and messaging boundaries:

  • Essential Service Communications: Messages regarding your booking confirmation, clinic directions, appointment reminders, webinar joining links, and transaction receipts are sent as essential operational service updates.
  • Optional Promotional Guidance: We do not spam. General Ayurvedic joint health tips, educational updates, or clinic announcements are sent only where you have explicitly opted in or consented. You can opt out of non-essential promotional messages at any time by replying "STOP" on WhatsApp or emailing our clinic desk.

5. Information Sharing & Non-Disclosure

We strictly do not sell, rent, lease, or trade your personal or health data to third-party telemarketers, insurance brokers, or advertisers. Your data is accessed only by authorized clinical and administrative personnel directly involved in managing your care or providing patient support.

6. Data Security & Retention Standards

Patient intake records and appointment histories are stored with end-to-end transport encryption (HTTPS / SSL 256-bit). Records are retained in accordance with applicable healthcare record retention standards in India. You maintain the right to review, update, or request the erasure of your personal contact information from our active communication databases by contacting our clinic administration.
